propositions.text: page(items, cursor, size) returns a two-element list [page_items, next_cursor].
A page contains only items strictly greater than the cursor, so the id equal to the cursor is never repeated.
A page contains at most size items, stopping once size items are collected even if more remain.
next_cursor is the last id on the returned page.
If the returned page is empty, next_cursor is null.
When cursor is None, every item is eligible and paging starts from the smallest id.
items is a list of integers already sorted in ascending order, and items are taken in ascending order.
An empty page signals that the end of the list has been reached.
